name: Relevance
description: Measures how closely the summary captures the main topics and events of the original article.

name: Clarity
description: Assesses the clarity of the summary, including grammar, syntax, and overall readability.

name: Conciseness
description: Evaluates the brevity of the summary while retaining essential information from the original article.

name: Coverage
description: Determines how well the summary covers all key points from the original article without missing significant details.
scale: 1 (misses most key points) to 5 (covers all key points)

name: Engagement
description: Rates how engaging or interesting the summary is for the reader, including the use of language and narrative style.

name: Objectivity
description: Measures the neutrality of the summary, assessing whether it presents the information without bias or subjective opinions.
